name: Relativistic Doppler Effect and Aberration
methods: Identify velocity vector and line of sight angle between source and observer
Apply relativistic Doppler equation including time dilation gamma factor
Compute transverse Doppler effect (pure time dilation at 90 degrees)
Calculate relativistic beaming and aberration angles in photon emission
problem_types: Astrophysical jet beaming and apparent superluminal motion
Laboratory verification via Ives-Stilwell transverse Doppler experiments
Satellite relativistic clock frequency shifts in orbit
pitfalls: Using classical Doppler formulas for electromagnetic waves at relativistic speeds
Neglecting the transverse Doppler effect which has no classical counterpart
